profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Blizzard Entertainment
profile.summary:
Software engineer who loves to work in data-driven environments. I have a versatile skill set, with specializations in backend services, distributed computing, and mobile.

I’ve had opportunities to work on a variety of engineering products in my career. Including, but not limited to: web services, API's, microservices, cross-platform libraries, mobile apps, big data, CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud infrastructure.

[Strongest Languages] 
Java, Go, C++, Scala, Python, Bash, SQL, Objective-C / Swift, Javascript 

[Key Technologies] 
Cassandra, MySQL, Docker, Protobuf, AWS, GCP, Linux, Kubernetes, Jenkins, iOS, Apache Spark, Hadoop, Kafka, ElasticSearch, Airflow, BigQuery

[Tools] 
Git, Jira, Confluence, World of Warcraft

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Build player facing + in-game services using Java/Go that deliver real-time recommendation and A/B testing systems
• Configure, build, and deploy cloud microservices

positions.title: Software Engineer, Mobile
positions.description:
• iOS developer for MFour's location triggered Surveys On The Go app
• C++ cross-platform mobile library development
• Build mobile app API's, geolocation services, and interactive data applications
• Build data architecture for mobile data using Scala, Apache Spark, and AWS
• Integrate with data stores such as S3, MySQL, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, Redis

educations.fieldOfStudy: A.S. in Computer Science: Computer Languages
